policy: All financial values in these fixtures are real, verbatim SEC-reported values. Nothing was invented, rounded, or synthesized except the explicitly marked synthetic fixture (tests/fixtures/sec/synthetic_edge_cases.json), which must never be treated as real company data (SPEC 26).

fixtures.trim_rule: Kept only the 'us-gaap' taxonomy nodes for the exact tags listed in data/tagmap_us.yml (data/dei and all other us-gaap tags removed). Within each kept tag, kept every unit observation whose period 'end' is >= '2023-06-01' (covers the FY2023 annual period, needed as the prior-year comparative, through the latest quarters as of the fetch date) verbatim, including val, accn, fy, fp, form, filed, frame and start/end fields. The tag RevenueFromContractWithCustomerIncludingAssessedTax is absent because Apple genuinely never reported it in the source payload; the remaining revenue fallback list is intact.
